text:
Priya: Heads-up: deploying batcher v2 tomorrow 10:00 UTC. Plan to enable feature flag `use-new-batcher` in canary (5% -> 25% -> 100%). Need rollout steps, pin guidance, and a rollback trigger.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy 8030001234 queued for 2026-03-24T10:00Z. Will run FF toggles as ops instructed. Remember to set `pin_version` if needed.

Sasha: @Priya please add model pin: `batcher:v2-build-119` pinned for canary. Also request metrics gate: latency p95 + error-rate.

Marco: I recommend initial 5% for 30m then 25% for 1h. Keep warmup cache disabled during canary. Add backoff policy: if p95 > +50ms OR errors > 0.5%, revert to v1.

Oliver: Release notes: call out perf improv (~12% CPU), and note config opt-in steps. I'll draft a short blurb.

Priya: commands I'll run post-deploy:
```
/ff toggle use-new-batcher on --cohort canary --percent 5 --reason "canary deploy" 
/ff watch use-new-batcher --gate p95:>50ms,err:>0.5% --window 15m
```

ops-alert-bot: Alert: latency spike + p95 +80ms on route /generate at 2026-03-24T10:23Z (canary cohort). Investigating.

Sasha: Pausing ramp. @deploy-bot hold toggles. Rollback criteria hit. Marco please prepare rollback plan.

Marco: Ack. Rolling flag back to v1 for canary and draining tokens pinned to batcher:v1. `/ff toggle use-new-batcher off --cohort canary --reason "auto rollback - latency"`

deploy-bot: Toggling feature flag off for cohort canary (affected cohorts: canary). Action executed.

Priya: Confirming canary back to v1. Opening postmortem thread and adding telemetry set. Thanks team :pray:

Oliver: I pushed release note draft in #release-notes, tagging product for a follow-up.

Yara: FYI we saw cache cold-start. Recommend adding small warmup before next canary.

Priya: Noted. We'll run a dry-run with warmup and tighter watch windows before next attempt. Closing thread.
